quests.title: The Dead Patch at Canley Vale
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The number three green at Canley Vale has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since a public holiday nobody remembered, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Canley Vale
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by a public holiday nobody remembered, which means finding $39 that the Canley Vale club does not have. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: $39, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Canley Vale Membership Count
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Our books say 46 members at Canley Vale and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Canley Vale
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Since half six somebody has been going round the Canley Vale greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Canley Vale
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. There is a bucket of odd keys in the chest freezer behind the bar at Canley Vale and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Canley Vale
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Cabramatta now, and he owes Canley Vale an explanation about the drainage. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Every night around knock-off the same car does three laps of the Pyrmont Bay forecourt and never buys fuel. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Pyrmont Bay at knock-off, because it is not going home. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: follow it as far as The Star
wherever it stops

quests.title: Bay Two, Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Bay two at the Pyrmont Bay workshop has had the same car in it since school holidays and the owner has stopped answering. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.title: Tools Off the Bench, Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Someone has been walking out of Pyrmont Bay with a socket set at a time since school holidays, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$50 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Pyrmont Bay Price Board
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Head office says the Pyrmont Bay board has been wrong since school holidays and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.title: The Other Franchise, Pyrmont Bay
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The bloke who runs the site at Town Hall has had the same trouble Pyrmont Bay has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: find him on shift
whatever he says, I want it word for word

quests.title: Level Two, Riverwood
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Water has been coming through the level two ceiling of the Riverwood block since the long weekend and the strata report says there is no water. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the ceiling, with the stain visible
that goes in the file whether they like it or not

quests.title: The Special Levy, Riverwood
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The photo did it. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Now every owner at Riverwood owes $38 and I have to collect it from people who have avoided me for a year. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: $38 out of them, in any state
I will not ask how

quests.title: Car Space 14, Riverwood
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Somebody who does not live at Riverwood has parked in space fourteen every night since the long weekend and the manager will not look at it. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: down to the basement, the far corner
the car in the space with the number painted beside it

quests.title: The Meeting, Riverwood
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The Riverwood AGM is on the long weekend and I would like to arrive with something stronger than a grievance and a printout. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: two coffees, one is for me
the community room where they hold it
walk in with me, they behave when there is a witness

quests.title: Bin Night at Riverwood
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Three units at Riverwood have put their bins out on the wrong night since the long weekend and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: the ones who argue about it
the fine the council gave me, off them

quests.title: The Other Block, Riverwood
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. There is a block at Narwee with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Riverwood is starting. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: go and ask them how it ended
I need to know how much worse this gets
